name: Record Work Checkpoint
summary: Append a redacted, hash-chained work checkpoint to the session ledger with a verified git anchor.
description: Invoked as a slash command, appends a structured checkpoint (goal, pending claims, decisions, touched files) to .youdede/session-ledger.jsonl. Content is redacted for secret shapes, size-bounded, and chain-linked by the deterministic ledger bridge.
risk_reason: This command appends a redacted, hash-chained work checkpoint to the session ledger with a verified git anchor; it does not modify or delete existing ledger entries; the ledger is append-only.
refuses: It does not store secrets, tokens, or credentials; content matching secret shapes is redacted before append.
It does not store absolute or escaping file paths, or file contents beyond declared fields.
It does not modify or delete existing ledger entries; the ledger is append-only.

entrypoints.purpose: Evaluate the declared preconditions deterministically before the workflow may begin.

produces: a ledger entry whose hash, sequence, and git anchor are reported back for citation

operational.latency_reason: The command follows a precondition check and multiple workflow steps while it appends a redacted, hash-chained work checkpoint to the session ledger with a verified git anchor.
